title: corpus-polish — the wireframe recreation on a site's page, the section index, the two prefixes, one deletion (Sonnet, group `websites`)

set.request: corpus-polish brief: wire drawing on the site page, three hand-written wires, title shortening, sections index made clickable, two css-scopes lines + 4-equal deletion
set.now: documentation pass done (readmes, schema.md, tools.md, decisions.md); proof screenshots captured at 400/1920 on :8123 across all 5 named pages, zero console errors; landing
steps: wire drawer on Site.js + schema.md doc
write three wires by hand (mdn-css, stripe, wikipedia-css)
sections index in tools/index.mjs + tag/layout pages
css-scopes.txt lines + delete 4-equal, alias to n-wall

links.label: the recreation: four shots + three wires + shortened title

set.outcome: **Wireframe recreation is live** on `/websites/wikipedia-css/` (and `mdn-css`, `stripe`) — the same page with the content taken out, drawn at 400/1920/3440 under the four real shots, reusing `/layouts/Layout.js`'s own drawer (a new shared static, `Layout.shot()`). The three hand-written wires are close, not exact: wikipedia-css and mdn-css read as `3-holy-grail`, centred with growing margins at 3440, matching their `centred at 1920` + `max-width` tags; stripe reads as bands — hero, a logo row that never wraps, an uneven 3-card bento — matching `1-centered` + `bento`. A site page's title now shows the record's own title (brand suffix trimmed) with the url slug beside it in small type, settling from a cold-link slug once the record loads. `index.mjs` writes a new `sections` manifest key (9 layout ids, from 40 sites) beside `tags`; `/websites/tag/<id>/` and `/layouts/<id>/` both draw a second "as a section, on:" list from it. `4-equal` is deleted from `layouts.json` (its own `when` sentence said to use `n-wall`) and kept as an alias of `n-wall`, so `/layouts/4-equal/` still resolves; the tree is 12 cards, not 13. `std-` and `site-` are now in `css-scopes.txt`; all four stale "not yet in css-scopes" notes found (two named in the brief, two more in Layout's own comments) are gone or resolved. `rg 4-equal public/` still finds the alias, the decisions note, two of my own explanatory comments, and sibling-owned site records/logs outside my write fence — expected, not stale.
